what_it_is: State fee for a Schengen visa (adults): "Schengen visa 90 Euros"
how_far_read: page of the Estonian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, read through a fetch tool that returned the text; quote copied word for word
note: A service fee of the external provider is charged on top ("Service fee will be charged when submitting the application at the offices of the external service provider"). Not counted

what_it_is: The fee is not paid back when the visa is refused: "The payment of the fee does not imply granting of the visa, nor does it entail refund in case of refusal."
Sufficient financial means for each day of stay in Estonia: "The extent of sufficient financial means for each day of stay in Estonia is 70 euros."
note: Only a per-day figure is given; the total is 70 times the days of the stay. Check the figure again before the first run: other sites state other amounts

what_it_is: Travel medical insurance: "travel medical insurance with coverage at least 30,000 Euros. Insurance must be valid in all Schengen Member States"
Exchange rate assumed in the guidance so that the model can compare dirhams with euros
note: Not a market quote. The dirham is pegged to the US dollar at 3.6725; the euro rate moves. Fix one value before the first run and state it

what_it_is: "As a general rule, a decision is taken by the consulate within 15 days from the date the application has been considered admissible." Up to 45 days in individual cases
Each savings level in the applications is 1.5 times the one before: AED 2000 3000 4500 7000 10500
note: See ../applicants/README.md. 8 days at EUR 70 is EUR 560, which is about AED 2352: the lowest level is below it, the second is just above it
